The body is eta times (reply_i gradient +(1/lambda)(x_i-mix(q,x)_i)), identical to ghat0. The body sums W_ij times v_j over insert i (G.neighborFinset i), retaining self plus precisely the neighbors and no normalization change. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.

Compiler projection types give n,dim,G,decidable adjacency,W,lambda,eta,K,x0 with the appropriate dependent dimensions. This is the reused raw algorithm input; the future tuned factory must compute eta and exclude the analysis minimizer. The compiled Algorithm.mk has Unit seed, Dirac law, stacked-point state, initial x0, query (0,x), update step q x r, and identity output. It queries one oracle once per outer update and returns the current last iterate. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.

The compiled value is localBase_i +(1-eta/lambda)g_i -eta*(reply_i Hessian)(g_i) +(eta/lambda)*mix(q,g)_i. It keeps x and its reply fixed through the inner loop and uses neighbor direction values in exactly the source order. The compiled body applies Nat.iterate to innerStep q x r exactly q.K-1 times, starting at localBase q x r. Thus K=1 returns ghat0 and every positive K returns ghat_(K-1). The body sums W_ij times v_j over insert i (G.neighborFinset i), retaining self plus precisely the neighbors and no normalization change. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.

The compiled body is x-direction q x r, with the source minus sign and no extra evaluation or selector. It queries one oracle once per outer update and returns the current last iterate. The body iterates x↦step q x (localOracle q f x) k times from q.x0, with local derivatives refreshed at each outer point. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.
The body is M+2*(1-wmin)/lambda, exactly the source curvature bound. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.

C2 real functions have self-adjoint derivative-of-gradient at every point in a complete real inner product space. Network symmetry plus A1 C2 give self-adjoint penalty Hessians for all x,u,v, matching DSYM. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.

C2 and global Hessian Lipschitz constant L yield the upper second-order Taylor expansion with remainder L/6||y-x||^3. Direction y-x and factor1/2 on the Hessian term agree with source. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.

The global lower Hessian quadratic bound c||v||^2 gives g(x)+<grad g(x),y-x>+c/2||y-x||^2<=g(y), for arbitrary x,y. It includes the source finite-dimensional instance. The upper Hessian bound yields the same expansion as an upper bound on g(y), with exact factor c/2 and no added sign assumption. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.

The compiler constructor/recursor has exactly n,dim,G,adjDecidable,W,lambda,m,M,L,Delta,epsilon,K,x0. It has neither eta nor a free outer count nor f,oracle,minimizer. K is the fixed inner depth passed unchanged to sourceInput. The compiled body is A=M+2/lambda, an accessible upper bound on source a=M+2(1-wmin)/lambda because Network has0<=wmin<=1. The compiled body is C=1+A+A^2*K^2/m+sqrt(A^4*(2A)^(3/2)*K^3*L*sqrt(Delta)/(6m^5)). The3/2 exponent, nested square roots and denominator6m^5 exactly match the reviewed derived tuning. The body is eta=1/(2C), computed solely from known Public fields. It is independent of the hidden minimizer and true gap. The body is rho=m^2/(2AC), the planned positive lower bound on the source rate; this definition does not itself assert the bound. The body is Nat.ceil((2AC/m^2)*log(max(1,Delta/epsilon))). Under valid epsilon>0 and Delta>=0 it gives zero when Delta<=epsilon and logarithmic accuracy dependence otherwise. K remains separate. The actual source Public constructor preserves n,dim,G,decidability,W,lambda,K,x0 and supplies stepSize p as eta; it exposes no hidden instance field. The body applies the previously reviewed dobocK directly to sourceInput p. All state/query/update/output behavior and the single full derivative-tuple oracle are retained. The exact individually inspected compiler contract/source is unchanged in the assembled project.
